Method of Attack: Stealing payment card data by encoding it into a JPG image stored on the infected website
Malicious PHP code modification to load additional malicious code via getAuthenticates function
Capturing checkout page data through the Customer_ parameter including payment card details, phone number, postal address, and email if logged in
Attack Vector: Compromised online store via vulnerability or weakness allowing planting of malicious code
Indicators of Compromise: Modified PHP file with getAuthenticates function
Presence of JPG image storing encoded payment card data in public location of infected store
